landmarks.name: Eiffel Tower
landmarks.hint: A wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars, symbol of France

landmarks.name: Louvre Museum
landmarks.hint: The world's largest art museum and historic monument, home to the Mona Lisa

landmarks.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral
landmarks.hint: A medieval Catholic cathedral on the Île de la Cité, famed for its Gothic architecture

landmarks.name: Arc de Triomphe
landmarks.hint: A triumphal arch at the western end of the Champs-Élysées, honouring those who fought for France

landmarks.name: Sacré-Cœur Basilica
landmarks.hint: A white-domed basilica dedicated to the Sacred Heart of Christ, atop Montmartre hill

landmarks.name: Musée d'Orsay
landmarks.hint: A museum in a former railway station on the Left Bank, housing the world's largest Impressionist collection

landmarks.name: Centre Pompidou
landmarks.hint: A controversial inside-out architectural landmark housing a modern art museum in Beaubourg

landmarks.name: Place de la Bastille
landmarks.hint: A historic square where the storming of the Bastille fortress ignited the French Revolution in 1789

landmarks.name: Luxembourg Gardens
landmarks.hint: Beautiful gardens surrounding the Palais du Luxembourg on the Left Bank, a beloved Parisian escape

landmarks.name: Père Lachaise Cemetery
landmarks.hint: The world's most visited cemetery, resting place of Chopin, Oscar Wilde, and Jim Morrison
